name: vCard-Generator
description: A production-ready React application that generates vCard QR codes for seamless digital tap-to-save contact sharing. Officially adopted by Professor's and multiple departments at my College to create and share professional digital business cards.

paragraphs: A simple and efficient web application built using React, HTML, and CSS that allows users to generate a vCard-compliant QR code. When scanned, this QR code auto-fills contact details in the user's phone contacts app — perfect for networking, business cards, and events.
features: 📝 Input form for Name, Phone, Email, Organization, etc.
⚡ Real-time QR code generation using vCard format
📱 Mobile-ready: scan and auto-save contact in one tap
